text: [assistant.text] I've changed the wording, and the same words now appear everywhere this feature shows up: - **The button** says what it does next: **"Hide filtered"** while everything is shown, **"Show filtered"** while the filtered parts are folded away. The icon changes with it (fold or unfold). The tooltip says the button affects both the text and the graph. - **Folded lines in the text** read "⋯ 35 filtered". Clicking one shows those filtered parts. - **Folded boxes in the graph** read "⋯ 2 filtered". Because the label now names the action, the button no longer looks "pressed"; that styling would have contradicted it. I reran the folding checks in a browser with the new labels, and folding, unfolding and hovering behave as before. All 63 tests pass. Committed as a84fde2, not pushed. …
